verdict.rationale: Khoj documents a first-party WhatsApp client: users can chat with it on WhatsApp without any desktop client, and slash commands such as /online and /dream work there. That delivers the core of talking to the assistant from an everyday messenger rather than a bespoke web page. However, WhatsApp is the only messenger evidenced, and nothing independent confirms how well it works. Missing for 10: Telegram, Discord, Slack or iMessage surfaces; independent or hands-on corroboration of the WhatsApp experience.
